# nowcast

> Provides bridge equations with optional autoregressive terms for nowcasting low-frequency macroeconomic variables (e. Install with `install.packages("nowcast")`.

Version: 0.1.0. License: MIT.

## Functions

- [`nc_aggregate()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/nowcast/reference/nc_aggregate.html): Temporal Aggregation
- [`nc_align()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/nowcast/reference/nc_align.html): Align Mixed-Frequency Time Series
- [`nc_available()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/nowcast/reference/nc_available.html): List Available Nowcasting Methods
- [`nc_backtest()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/nowcast/reference/nc_backtest.html): Pseudo-Real-Time Backtesting
- [`nc_bridge()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/nowcast/reference/nc_bridge.html): Bridge Equation Nowcast
- [`nc_compute()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/nowcast/reference/nc_compute.html): Compute a Nowcast by Method Name
- [`nc_dm_test()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/nowcast/reference/nc_dm_test.html): Diebold-Mariano Test for Equal Predictive Accuracy
- [`nc_evaluate()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/nowcast/reference/nc_evaluate.html): Evaluate Nowcast Accuracy
- [`nc_ragged_edge()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/nowcast/reference/nc_ragged_edge.html): Summarise Ragged-Edge Data Availability
- [`nc_transform()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/nowcast/reference/nc_transform.html): Stationarity Transformations

## Documentation

- [Full reference](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/nowcast/reference/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/charlescoverdale/nowcast)
